item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Jeffree Star - Unreleased tracks
item.description:
Requesting all tracks that aren't available on streaming, such as Don't Cha remix, Heart Surgery Isn't That Bad, I Hate Music, Starstruck, etc.

I understand lossless won't be available for most leaked content.

Heart Surgery in particular is one I want in hq, but the highest I can find is 128. Discogs says 256 though.
I have a few of these already in LQ but was hoping for best possible quality.

(The fact that I can't find Texxxt Bomb in anything but 128 is a hate crime.)


Here's a list of songs.
https://unreleasedsaga.wordpress.com/2016/05/14/jeffree-star/



Please, thank.



edit ; it looks like I Hate Music and Heart Surgery are STILL on Apple, if someone knows how to rip from that.
